buyBody: 450cc of titanium at 10.5 degrees, on a 45-inch stiff graphite shaft, in gold. One specification, no options to get wrong, and the loudest-looking club we make.
whatYouGet: No headcover (none of our clubs ship with one)
clubHeadline: One driver. One spec. No fitting appointment.
clubParas: Most driver purchases involve an hour in a bay, four shaft options and a number you do not fully understand. This one comes in exactly one configuration, which is either a limitation or a relief depending on how that hour usually goes for you.

450cc at 10.5 degrees is the middle of the road on purpose: enough loft to get the ball up for a normal swing speed, enough head to forgive a strike off the heel. The crown is shaped to cut through the air rather than to look fast in a photograph.
The shaft is 45 inches of 61-gram stiff graphite, which is light enough to swing and firm enough not to wander at the top. The grip is a standard-size Runner.
It is $299, which for a titanium driver is the number that needs no further explanation. There is more on the pricing if you want it.

specTabs.aside: Stiff is the only flex and 45" the only length. Shopify records this club as having no variant options at all, which is why the buy box shows no pickers. There is genuinely nothing to choose.

look.photo: Bold, full-bleed, portrait. Gold crown at address on a tee box in low sun, sky behind. A driver is the biggest object in the bag and this shot should make that the point.
look.headline: There is no quiet way to carry a gold driver
paras: A 450cc gold head is the most visible thing you will own. It sits at the top of the bag, it comes out on the first tee, and everybody in the group sees it before you have hit a shot.
That is either a good reason to buy it or a good reason not to, and there is no third option.
look.aside: Everyone else is carrying the same club with someone else's name on it. It's better to be lucky.

closeBody: The Driver is $299, one specification, gold. Sixty days to send it back if it isn't the one.
